name: Acceptance suite-3 test 56 - duplicate Action key, dangerous value LAST -> BLOCKED
note: docs/acceptance-suite-3.md Campaign A. Order-independence control for test 55: the dangerous iam:* value now appears LAST. The engine must still fail closed with DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY - it must NOT continue merely because the retained value would generate a high-risk finding. Duplicate rejection is a syntax invariant, not a risk-dependent heuristic.
rationale: Duplicate-key rejection must be independent of which value survives a last-key-wins parse. If the engine only blocked when the retained value looked benign, an attacker could bypass the guard by ordering the dangerous value last. The block is a structural JSON invariant applied before any risk evaluation. Ref: RFC 8259 section 4 + IAM JSON policy grammar.
